text:
Maya Patel: Quick Q — for the new analytics-service SA, should we grant it org-level logging roles or keep it project-scoped? It needs to read logs across 3 prod projects for feature telemetry. Also we must avoid exposing user_email / SSN fields in forwarded logs. Suggestions?

Ethan Chen: keep it project-scoped if possible. Don’t give org-level roles unless we absolutely need org-wide admin. Two patterns: 1) grant the SA reading IAM on each prod project, or 2) create a dedicated telemetry project + log sinks from prod projects and give the SA access there. I prefer sink + telemetry project for auditing and redaction control.

Ethan Chen: For redaction, use log router/exclusion or transform filters to drop PII before it lands in the telemetry project. Example filter idea (customize): `resource.type=\"k8s_container\" AND NOT jsonPayload.user_email:*` — but better to use router transforms.

Dmitri Sokolov: note: if humans need to view logs in Console, they often need `roles/logging.viewer` (or viewer/browser) which shows full payloads. So don’t mix SA console-facing roles with service-only API roles. Grant console roles to groups of engineers, not to SAs.

Sana Lopez: +1 to sink approach. Also recommend creating a narrow custom role with only `logging.logEntries.list` and `logging.logEntries.get` (and maybe `logging.sinks.list` if you need to manage sinks) and bind that to the telemetry project. Server-side redaction via sinks/advanced transforms is the safest way to ensure PII never leaves prod.

Sana Lopez: quick custom role example:
```json
{
  "title": "Telemetry Log Reader",
  "includedPermissions": [
    "logging.logEntries.list",
    "logging.logEntries.get",
    "logging.sinks.list"
  ]
}
```

Ethan Chen: gcloud example to bind SA to the telemetry project role (replace names):
```bash
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding telemetry-prod \
  --member=\"serviceAccount:analytics-sa@ourorg.iam.gserviceaccount.com\" \
  --role=\"projects/telemetry-prod/roles/TelemetryLogReader\"
```

InfraBot: Automated check: analytics-sa currently has `roles/editor` on `proj-prod-1` (found via nightly-iam-scan). Recommend removing editor and using sink + custom role. Opened suggested change: https://git.internal/infra/iam/changes/234

Maya Patel: OK will remove editor from proj-prod-1 and create a sink + custom role PR. @Ethan @Sana can you review the IAM PR when I open it? planning to do it today.

Ethan Chen: Yup, will review. :thumbsup:

Sana Lopez: I’ll review too.

Maya Patel: Thanks all — will update thread when PR is up"
